standard_prerequisites.name: The characterization of constructible subsets as finite unions of differences of retrocompact opens, and the constructibility of the pieces used in the family
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 5832-5834 and 5838-5840)
standard_prerequisites.use: Writes each piece as a difference of retrocompact opens and shows each member of the resulting family is constructible.

core_obligations: Reduce to differences: by the definition of constructibility each subset is a finite union of differences of retrocompact opens, so one may assume each given subset is such a difference (proof lines 5831-5835)

Build a finite intersection-closed family: take the finite set of closed subsets generated by the empty set, the whole space and the complements of the retrocompact opens, closed under finite intersections, and note every member is constructible (proof lines 5836-5841)
Stratify: order the family by inclusion and take the successive differences, which gives a finite stratification by constructible pieces refining the given union (proof lines 5842-5844)
proof_roadmap: 把每个 T_i 写成有限个 U ∩ V^c（U、V 是 retrocompact 开）之并 ⇒ 不妨设 T_i = U_i ∩ V_i^c。
取有限族 S = ⟨∅, X, U_i^c, V_i^c⟩ 对有限交封闭；每个成员可构造。
按包含排序，令 X_Z = Z ∖ ∪_{Z' < Z} Z'，即得有限可构造层化且细化原并。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a finite union of constructible subsets of a topological space is refined by a finite stratification whose strata are constructible (author lemma at source lines 5823-5829, label lemma-constructible-partition-refined-by-stratification). The proof (source lines 5831-5845) writes each piece as a difference of retrocompact opens, forms a finite intersection-closed family of constructible closed subsets and takes successive differences to obtain the stratification (proof lines 5831-5844). The construction of the family and the successive-difference step are the content. H3.
